latestVersion.changelog:
ai-test-platform 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces an AI-powered automated testing platform using LangChain and DeepSeek LLM for internal company use.
- Supports intelligent test case generation, API (Pytest+Requests) and UI (Playwright) automation, with Docker-based execution isolation.
- Implements detailed authorization management with role-based permissions and AES-encrypted codes.
- Provides modules for test case/script management, execution tracking, report generation (with AI-powered analysis), and system configuration.
- Includes database schema, unified API design, and Docker-based deployment setup for persistence and scalability.
